Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 10
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner arbitrarily applied an “earlier-year tie-breaker” and concluded 405 CE, despite evidence that the invasion in question—the Rhine crossing by Vandals, Alans, and Suebi—occurred at the end of 406 CE (traditionally December 31, 406). WebSurfer had already surfaced a source stating Dec 31, 406, and Britannica references frame the event in 406–407/405–406, none justifying 405 as the “end-of-year” date. The Planner misinterpreted the phrasing “at the end of which year” and prematurely finalized an incorrect answer.
